name: ai-intelligence-daily-mobile
description: AI Intelligence Daily - 移动端本地应用（iOS/Android）

scripts.init: npx cap init ai-intelligence-daily com.aiintelligence.daily --web-dir www --web-dir www
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cp ../output/Daily_Report_*.html www/index.html 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android

author: AI Intelligence Daily
